Exact rules and assumptions

  1. HTF strictly sweeps the previous HTF high and closes below it for bearish; strictly sweeps the low and closes above it for bullish. All HTFs must be closed and complete.
  2. Freeze the same CantoLab directional-run CISD level at the sweep close. Ignore all earlier reclaim flags. Only LTF candles starting at or after that HTF close may confirm, using a strict close beyond the frozen level. This is a close-beyond predicate, not a new crossover requirement.
  3. Entry and R both use the later CISD confirming close, as explicitly selected by the user. SL is the exact sweep high/low. TP is entry plus/minus twice the entry-to-stop distance. Non-positive risk cannot be traded.
  4. No C3/C4 expiry, T-spot invalidation, same-direction replacement, pre-entry wick rejection, or strategy invalidation exit. Pending sweeps wait without a time limit. One entry per sweep; no repeated entries from the same sweep.
  5. Every qualifying sweep trades independently. Simultaneous opposite positions, overlapping positions and multiple sweeps confirmed by the same candle are all included. The card display does not select trades.
  6. Both modes start flat on 1 January 2025; December 16-31, 2024 warms the indicator, so unconfirmed December sweeps can still confirm in January. Carry exits only at SL/TP. Daily mode additionally exits at the actual session close (normally 15:30, Muhurat 14:45), with no new entry at that closing instant.
  7. Evaluate SL/TP only after entry. Stop gaps fill at the subsequent open; target gaps at the target. Same-minute double hits use stop first. Stops can lose more than 1R across gaps. Open horizon positions have no realized P&L.
  8. Realized R is summed per independent trade. Simultaneous exit timestamps are grouped for drawdown. This is not account percentage return; concurrent trades require concurrent risk exposure. No capital, margin, netting or compounding constraints are imposed.
  9. Both frozen public archives cover 249 sessions and 93,060 minute candles in 2025. Verified holidays, Budget Saturday and Muhurat hours are included. The archives differ on 6,847 OHLC rows (7.36%). No minute data is invented or forward-filled.
  10. A missing data path would leave its exposed position unresolved; it would not block unrelated later trades. Missing LTF data resets pending confirmation state because an intervening CISD cannot be determined.
  11. Gross theoretical index results assume immediate close-price information. Delayed Yahoo cannot be assumed to obtain these fills. Options premiums, strikes, expiries, spreads and Greeks are not modelled. One-index-point cost sensitivity is illustrative only.
  12. The CISD level code is source-derived. The simplified lifecycle is deliberately different from the full Pine indicator, and has not been executed in TradingView Pine runtime.
